<!--
Elevation across ecosystem
-->

```{r elevation_text, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$elevation)) {
  elev_text <- "Elevation calculation was not requested."
} else {
  elev_q <- global(params$elevation, quantile, probs=c(0.05,.95), na.rm=TRUE)
  
  elev_text <- paste0(
    "The elevation of the mapped ecosystem in ", max(params$years),
    " ranged from ", as.numeric(min(values(params$elevation), na.rm=TRUE)),
    "m to ", as.numeric(max(values(params$elevation), na.rm=TRUE)),
    "m, with 95% of the ecosystem elevation between ",
    elev_q[1], "m and ", elev_q[2], "m. he elevation distribution across the ecosystem is shown in the graph below:"
  )
}
```
**Elevation:** `r elev_text`

```{r elevation, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,  fig.align = "center", out.width = '100%', fig.height=3, eval = !is.null(params$elevation)}
elev_values <- as.numeric(values(params$elevation, na.rm = TRUE))  # get numeric vector without NAs

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  # --- Interactive Plotly ---
  e_plot <- plot_ly(x = elev_values, type = "histogram", marker=list(color="#669900")) %>%
        layout(xaxis = list(title = "Elevation (m)"),
               yaxis = list(title = "Number of mapped pixels"),
               bargap = 0.1)
  e_plot

} else {
  # --- Static ggplot for PDF/Word ---
   e_plot <- ggplot(temp_avg, aes(x = month, group=1)) +
  # smoothed ribbon
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_smooth, ymax = max_smooth),
              fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +

  # smoothed mean line
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_smooth), color = "blue", size = 1) +
    labs(title = "Average Monthly Temperature",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Temperature (°C)")+
    theme_classic() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype=5, linewidth=0.5, color="grey50"))

   e_plot
}
```
